_what: MEASURED: the CALIBRATION pattern (P3, weight 4) own FULL 8-run true-ZCS probe, A6-gated (|I(L)| <= 1 uA at every commanded open), as the beat shrinks.
_finding: A6 on the calibration schedule ITSELF develops a KNEE between T = 150 and T = 145 ps, and the failures are EXCLUSIVELY on the RETURN zeros (izq2, izq3), never the rise zeros. Below T ~ 150 ps the return ZCS instant can no longer be located to the inherited 1 uA tolerance by the committed sequential protocol at this swing.
_why_it_does_not_invalidate_t_valid: the SETUP budget depends on the RAIL-RAISE zero, which sets t_valid; the rise residuals stay at <= 0.0095 uA at EVERY beat. The return zero sets the initiation interval and the late edge, not the eye opening. Reported as a SEPARATE constraint on the beat, never folded into the timing budget.
_pre_registered_as: F2 (PRE_REGISTERED_P2.json B6). F2 was TRIGGERED at T = 145 and T = 140.
